itineraries.title: Arrival in Paro

content.itineraries:
Day 1 — Arrival in Paro
Arrive at Paro airport and drive to the hotel. In the afternoon visit Rinpung Dzong and the National Museum, then walk the old market street.

Day 2 — Taktsang Monastery hike
Hike to Taktsang Monastery, the Tiger's Nest, set on a cliff above the Paro valley. Lunch is at the cafeteria viewpoint before the walk back down.

Day 3 — Dochula Pass and Punakha
Drive over Dochula Pass to Punakha. Visit Punakha Dzong where two rivers meet and cross the suspension bridge before evening.

Day 4 — Paro and departure
Drive back to Paro along the river road and transfer to the airport for the departure flight.
